DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園の使い方で、何をご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to know about using the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お弁当を食べてから子供とボールで遊びたいです。この花壇の横の空いた所を使ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 弁当を食べて子供とボールで遊びたいと伝え、花壇横の空いた場所を使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to eat our packed lunches and then play ball with my child. Can we use the empty space beside this flower bed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to eat packed lunches and play ball with your child, and ask to use the empty space beside the flower bed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 飲食できる場所と、ボール遊びができる場所は分けて確認しましょう。現地の掲示はご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the places for eating and drinking separately from the places for ball games. Have you looked at the signs here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 座って休める表示だけ見ました。休憩できるならボールも使えると思っていましたが、別なんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見たのは休憩の表示だけで、休める場所ならボールも使えると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only saw the sign saying you can sit and rest. I thought somewhere you can rest would also allow balls, but they're separate, aren't they?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only saw the rest-area sign and thought somewhere for resting also allowed ball games. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 花壇横はボール遊びの区域ではありません。地図のこちらが食事のできる休憩区画、こちらがボール遊びの自由広場です。別の場所なので、食事の後に移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The space beside the flower bed isn't a ball-game area. Here on the map is the rest area where you can eat, and here is the open field for ball games. They're separate places, so please move after eating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子供は柔らかいボールだから大丈夫と言っています。でもボールの種類だけで決めず、区域の表示を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 柔らかいボールでも種類だけで判断せず、利用できる区域の表示を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My child says it'll be fine because the ball is soft. But I don't want to decide just from the type of ball; I'd like to check the signs for the permitted area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the signs showing the permitted area rather than judge only by the type of ball, even if it is soft. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自由広場の掲示では、柔らかいボールを使えます。花壇横で使えるという意味ではありません。広場でも周りに人がいれば、ぶつけないよう距離を取ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The open-field sign allows soft balls. That doesn't mean you can use them beside the flower bed. Even in the field, keep your distance from others so you don't hit them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では休憩区画でお弁当を食べてから、柔らかいボールを持って自由広場へ行きます。花壇横では出さず、広場でもほかの人と距離を取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩区画で食べた後に柔らかいボールを持って自由広場へ移り、花壇横では出さず広場でも他の人と距離を取ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then we'll eat our lunches in the rest area, then take the soft ball to the open field. We won't take it out beside the flower bed, and we'll keep our distance from others in the field, too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will eat in the rest area, move to the open field with the soft ball, keep it put away beside the flower bed, and keep your distance from others in the field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順番でご利用ください。食事のごみは持ち帰る案内です。食べた物を片付けて、お子さんと一緒に広場へ移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use the areas in that order. The instructions ask you to take your food rubbish home. Put away the meal items and move to the field together with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休憩区画で食べてごみを片付け、子供と自由広場へ行きます。柔らかいボールは広場でだけ使い、花壇横では遊びません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩区画で食べてごみを片付け、子供と自由広場へ移り、ボールは広場だけで使い花壇横では遊ばないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll eat in the rest area, clear up our rubbish, and go to the open field together. We'll use the soft ball only in the field and won't play beside the flower bed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will eat and clear up in the rest area, move to the open field with your child, and use the ball only there, not beside the flower bed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。掲示に従って、周りの方と譲り合ってご利用ください。楽しい時間をお過ごしください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please follow the signs and share the space considerately with others. Enjoy your time. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。駅のご利用で、何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with using the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この検索の乗り換えは短い時間ですが、大きい荷物があっても岩見沢で間に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きな荷物があるので、検索結果に出た短い乗り換え時間で間に合うか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This search gives a short transfer time. Can I make it at Iwamizawa even with large luggage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have large luggage and ask whether you can make the short transfer shown in the search results. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗る列車と到着する列車を確認しましょう。荷物を持って階段を移動できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check your arriving train and the train you'll board. Can you use stairs while carrying your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持ち上げるのは難しいです。検索には乗り換えの分数しかなく、階段を使う道かどうかは出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物を持ち上げるのは難しく、検索結果には階段を使うかどうかが表示されていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's difficult to lift it. The search only shows the number of minutes for the transfer, not whether the route uses stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that lifting your luggage is difficult and the search results do not show whether stairs are needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、昇降設備を使える経路と当日の利用状況を確認します。急がず移動できる便も候補にしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we'll check a route using lifts or similar equipment and whether the equipment is available that day. Let's also consider trains that let you move without rushing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 荷物を引いて移動したいです。最短の乗り換えにこだわらないので、次の列車にする場合も調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最短の乗り換えにこだわらず、荷物を引いて移動できる経路と次の列車を調べてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to wheel my luggage. I don't have to make the shortest transfer, so could you also look at taking the next train?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check a route where you can wheel your luggage and the next train, without insisting on the shortest transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。次の候補と、目的地への到着見込みを確認します。降りたホームからの移動は、駅の案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We'll check the next option and the expected arrival at your destination. Please follow station directions when moving from the platform you arrive on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 到着が遅くなっても大丈夫です。迎えの人には連絡します。通れない所があったら荷物を置かず、駅員に聞くことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着が遅れても構わず迎えの人に連絡し、通れない場所では荷物を置かず駅員に聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's okay if I arrive later. I'll contact the person meeting me. If there's somewhere I can't pass, I'll ask station staff without leaving my luggage there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say a later arrival is fine, you will contact the person meeting you, and will ask station staff without leaving your luggage if you cannot pass somewhere. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにしてください。設備の案内と移動経路を確認してから、利用する列車を選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do that. Let's check the equipment information and route before choosing which train to use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 階段を避けられる経路を確かめ、余裕のある候補で行きます。迎えの人に到着の見込みを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 階段を避けられる経路を確認して余裕のある列車を選び、迎えの人に到着見込みを知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check a route avoiding stairs and take an option with enough time. I'll tell the person meeting me my expected arrival.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check a stair-free route, choose a train with enough time, and inform the person meeting you of your expected arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。荷物を持って無理に急がないでください。移動で困った時はお声がけください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please don't force yourself to rush with your luggage. Let us know if you need help moving around. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。本日は何のお手続きでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What procedure are you here for today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申請した証明書を受け取りたいです。この控えがあるので、受け取りの窓口へ行けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 証明書の申請控えを示し、受取窓口へ行けばよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to collect the certificate I applied for. Since I have this application receipt, should I go to the collection counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show your certificate application receipt and ask whether to go to the collection counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何の証明書を、どの方法で申請されたか教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you tell me what certificate you applied for and how you applied?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: オンラインで住民票の写しを申し込みました。画面に支払い完了と出たので、もう出来上がったと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: オンラインで申請し、支払い完了の表示を見て証明書も出来上がったと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I applied online for a copy of my resident record. The screen said payment complete, so I thought the certificate was already ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you applied online and thought the certificate was ready because you saw a payment-complete message. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 支払いの完了と受け取りの準備完了は、同じ意味とは限りません。申請の案内に受取通知の説明はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Payment complete doesn't necessarily mean ready for collection. Do the application instructions explain a collection notification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メールには準備ができたら連絡するとあります。今日は支払いのメールだけなので、担当に状況を確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 準備完了の連絡はまだ来ていないと伝え、担当に申請状況を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The email says they'll contact me when it's ready. Today's email is only about payment, so I'd like the person in charge to check the status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not yet received a ready notification and ask the person in charge to check your application status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申請番号をもとに担当へおつなぎします。受取先は、こちらの庁舎を指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll refer you using your application number. Did you specify this municipal office as the collection location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認したら郵送を選んでいました。窓口受取のつもりで来たのですが、申請の内容も間違えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申請内容を見て郵送を選んでいたと分かったことを伝え、窓口受取だと思って来た誤解を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I checked, I had selected postal delivery. I came thinking I'd collect it at the counter, but I'd also misunderstood my application details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you discovered you selected postal delivery and correct your misunderstanding that you came to collect it at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 郵送の申請なら、その発送状況と変更の可否を担当にご確認ください。窓口で今お渡しできるとは申し上げられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: For a postal application, please check the dispatch status and whether changes are possible with the person in charge. I can't say we can hand it to you at the counter now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 申請番号を示して、郵送で申し込んだことを説明します。発送済みか、未発送なら変更できるかを確認してから待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 申請番号を示して郵送の申請だと説明し、発送状況と未発送の場合の変更可否を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll give my application number and explain that I applied for postal delivery. I'll check whether it's been sent, and whether I can change it if it hasn't, before waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show the application number, explain the postal application, and check dispatch status and whether a change is possible if not yet sent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内しますので、申請番号の画面をご用意ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you to the person in charge, so please have the screen showing your application number ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受診について、どのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What help do you need with your visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お腹が痛くて来ました。日本語でうまく説明できないので、この携帯のメモを見せてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 腹痛で来たが日本語の説明が不安だと伝え、携帯のメモを見せてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've come because I have stomach pain. I'm not confident explaining it in Japanese. May I show you the note on my phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have come with abdominal pain but are worried about explaining in Japanese, and ask to show your phone note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。今回の症状を書いたメモでしょうか。いつから痛むかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. Is the note about your current symptoms? Please also tell me when the pain started.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨夜からです。でも画面の最初は前回の頭痛のメモでした。今回は頭ではなく、お腹です。今回の部分だけ見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 腹痛は昨夜からで、画面の古い頭痛メモは今回の症状ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last night. But the first thing on the screen was a note about my previous headache. This time it's my stomach, not my head. I'll show only the part about this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the abdominal pain began last night and the old headache note on the screen is not about the current symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の症状として医療スタッフへお伝えします。今、座って待てますか。説明の聞き取りで困ることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the medical staff about these current symptoms. Can you sit and wait now? Is there anything that makes spoken explanations difficult for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 座れますが、早口だとわかりません。質問を一つずつ、短い言葉で言ってもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 座って待てるが早口は分かりにくいと伝え、質問を一つずつ短い言葉でしてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can sit, but I don't understand when people speak quickly. I'd like questions asked one at a time in short, simple phrases.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can sit and wait but fast speech is difficult, and request questions one at a time in short phrases. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その希望もお伝えします。わからない言葉は、わかったふりをせず聞き返してください。付き添いの方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass that request on, too. If you don't understand a word, please ask again rather than pretend you understand. Is someone accompanying you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は一人です。通訳の対応があるかも知りたいです。ない場合は、診察の説明を紙に書いてもらえるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は一人で来たと答え、通訳の可否と、難しい場合に説明を書いてもらえるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm on my own today. I'd also like to know whether interpreting is available. If not, I'd like to ask whether they can write down the consultation explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you came alone and ask whether interpreting is available and, if that is difficult, whether explanations can be written down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通訳などの対応可否は担当へ確認します。書面の説明についてもご希望を伝えますが、ここで対応を約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask the person in charge whether interpreting or similar support is available. I'll also pass on your request for written explanations, but can't promise that here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回の腹痛と昨夜からという時刻を伝えてください。古いメモは閉じて、ゆっくりした質問と説明方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回の腹痛と開始時刻を伝えてもらい、古いメモを閉じて質問の速さと説明方法を相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please tell them it's the current stomach pain and that it started last night. I'll close the old note and discuss slower questions and how explanations can be given.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the current abdominal pain and its starting time to be passed on, and say you will close the old note and discuss question speed and explanation methods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。医療スタッフへおつなぎします。待つ間につらくなったら、すぐ職員に知らせてください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Noted. I'll put you in touch with medical staff. If you feel worse while waiting, tell a staff member immediately. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことがありましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駐車場で車が接触したかもしれません。相手の車が出て行った後に擦れを見つけたので、相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐車場で接触があった可能性と、相手の車が去ってから擦れを見つけたことを伝えて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There may have been contact between cars in the car park. I noticed a scrape after the other car had left, so I'd like advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain there may have been contact in a car park and you found a scrape after the other car left, and ask for advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は安全な場所にいますか。けがをした方や、今つらい症状がある方はいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you in a safe place now? Has anyone been injured, or is anyone experiencing symptoms now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 車は安全な場所に止めています。今のところ痛みは感じていませんが、ぶつかった瞬間ははっきり見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 車は安全な場所にあり今は痛みを感じないが、接触の瞬間ははっきり見ていないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My car is parked somewhere safe. I don't feel pain at the moment, but I didn't clearly see the moment of contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the car is somewhere safe and you feel no pain now, but did not clearly see the moment of contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見たことと推測を分けて伺います。どの場所で、何時ごろだったか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll separate what you saw from your assumptions. Please tell me where and approximately when it happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この店の駐車場です。買い物前の写真には擦れがなく、戻った時の写真にはあります。写真の時刻も見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店の駐車場だと示し、買い物前後の写真で擦れの有無と時刻を確認できると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: In this shop's car park. There's no scrape in the photo from before shopping, and there is one in the photo from when I returned. I can also see the photo times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Indicate the shop's car park and explain that photos before and after shopping show whether the scrape was present and the times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真を確認します。相手の車について、実際に確認できた特徴や記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the photos. Do you have any features or records of the other car that you actually confirmed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 隣から出た白い車は見ました。でも番号を全部は覚えていません。その車が擦ったと断定せず、見えた部分だけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 隣から出た白い車を見たが番号は一部しか覚えておらず、その車が擦ったとは断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I saw a white car leave the neighboring space. But I don't remember the whole registration number. I won't state that it caused the scrape; I'll only tell you what I saw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you saw a white car leave the neighboring space but remember only part of its number, and will not conclude that it caused the scrape. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように、確認できた情報をお知らせください。事故に関する届出と、その後の確認方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please give us the information you confirmed in that way. We'll explain the accident report and how to check afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真二枚と場所と時刻を示します。白い車の番号は一部だけと伝え、必要な届出の手順を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚の写真と場所、時刻、覚えている番号の範囲を示し、必要な届出の手順を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the two photos, location, and times. I'll explain that I know only part of the white car's registration number. Please tell me the steps for the necessary report.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the two photos, location, times, and the extent of the number you remember, and ask about the required reporting steps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。順に状況を記録します。後から症状に気づいた場合も、その時の状況を適切な相談先へ伝えてください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll record the circumstances in order. If you notice symptoms later, too, explain the circumstances at that time to the appropriate service. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。発送について、どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about sending something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海外の家族に、署名して返してもらう書類を送りたいです。封筒で送れるかと、間に合う方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外の家族に署名して返してもらう書類を送りたいと伝え、封筒で送れるかと期限に合う方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send documents to my family overseas for them to sign and return. I'd like to know whether I can send them in an envelope and which method could meet the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to send documents overseas for family to sign and return, and ask whether an envelope is possible and which method meets the deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先の国と、送りたい物の内容を教えてください。書類以外の物も入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the destination country and what you want to send. Is there anything other than documents inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宛先はベトナムです。書類だけですが、原本を入れたつもりで、家に残す写しと混ざってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛先の国を伝え、書類だけだが原本と家に残す写しが混ざったことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The destination is Vietnam. It's only documents, but although I meant to put in the originals, I mixed them up with the copies I was going to keep at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the destination country and explain that it is documents only, but the originals and copies to keep at home got mixed up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず送る書類をお確かめください。必要な原本と控えを分けてから、発送方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, please check which documents you're sending. Once you've separated the required originals from your copies, let's check the shipping methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 署名欄のある原本を選び直しました。今月中に返送まで終えたいので、行きだけ速くても足りないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 署名欄のある原本を選び直したと伝え、今月中の返送には往路だけでなく復路の時間も必要だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've selected the originals with the signature fields again. I want the return delivery completed within this month, so a fast outward journey alone isn't enough, is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have reselected the originals with signature fields and confirm that a return within this month requires time for the return journey as well as the outward one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 往復の時間と相手が手続きする時間も必要です。受付可能な方法と、確認できる配送の見込みをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You'll need time for both journeys and for the recipient to handle the paperwork. We'll explain the methods we can accept and the delivery estimates we can check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 到着日が保証されると思っていましたが、見込みなんですね。追跡の有無と、相手が不在の時の確認先も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着日は保証ではなく見込みだと確認し、追跡の有無と相手が不在の場合の確認先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought the arrival date was guaranteed, but it's an estimate. I'd also like to ask whether tracking is available and whom to ask if the recipient is out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the arrival date is an estimate rather than guaranteed, and ask about tracking and whom to contact if the recipient is absent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 方法ごとに追跡や配達の扱いが異なります。宛先の条件を確認して比較しましょう。確実な返送期限まではお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tracking and delivery arrangements differ by method. Let's compare them after checking the destination conditions. We can't promise a definite return deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 原本を再確認し、家族の署名と返送時間も考えます。追跡と配達条件を比べて、期限が厳しければ提出先にも相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原本と家族の署名・返送時間を確認し、配送条件を比べても期限が厳しければ提出先へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll recheck the originals and allow time for my family to sign and send them back. I'll compare tracking and delivery conditions, and if the deadline is tight, consult the place I need to submit them to as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the originals and time for your family to sign and return them, and consult the submission recipient if the deadline remains tight after comparing delivery conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。宛先と書類の内容を確認してから、発送方法をご案内します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll explain the sending methods after checking the destination and document contents. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。通帳について、何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble with your passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: しばらく記帳していないのですが、通帳の金額が変わっていません。取引がなかったということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長く記帳していない通帳の金額が変わらないと伝え、取引がなかったという意味か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I haven't updated it for a while, but the amount in my passbook hasn't changed. Does that mean there were no transactions?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the amount in a passbook not updated for a long time is unchanged, and ask whether that means there were no transactions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通帳に記録されていない取引がある場合もあります。最後に記帳した日と、最近利用した手続きを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: There may be transactions not yet recorded in the passbook. Let's check when you last updated it and which banking procedures you've used recently.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最後は半年ほど前です。その後も家賃の引き落としがあるので、何も動いていないわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後の記帳は半年ほど前で、その後も家賃の引落しがあるので取引はあったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The last time was about six months ago. Rent has been debited since then, so it's not that there has been no activity, is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you last updated it about six months ago and rent debits since then mean there have been transactions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。記帳できる方法をご案内します。通帳の残りの記入欄も確認してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. I'll explain how to update it. May I also check the remaining entry space in your passbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: もう一行しかありません。機械に入れれば、半年分がその一行に全部入ると思っていました。足りない場合はどうなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記入欄が一行しか残っていないと伝え、半年分を記帳するには欄が足りない場合どうなるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's only one line left. I thought putting it in the machine would fit all six months into that one line. What happens if there isn't enough space?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say there is only one line left and ask what happens if there is not enough space for six months of entries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この通帳には一行しか残っていませんね。取扱い案内には、欄が足りなくなったら窓口で繰越を相談し、まとまった表示だけでは分からない取引は別の明細を照会するとあります。半年分が一行に全て個別記載されるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's only one line left in this passbook, yes. The instructions say to consult the counter about carrying it over to a new passbook when space runs out, and request separate details for transactions unclear from a combined entry. Six months of transactions won't necessarily all be listed individually on one line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しい通帳になるなら、古い通帳も手元に残したいです。家賃の支払いを確認する時に必要なので、捨てずに保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新しい通帳になる場合も、家賃の支払い確認に使う古い通帳を保管したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I get a new passbook, I'd like to keep the old one too. I need it to check my rent payments, so I'll store it rather than throw it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to keep the old passbook for checking rent payments even if you get a new one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 過去の取引を確認する資料として保管できます。明細が必要な期間と、表示で不明な取引を整理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can keep it as a record for checking past transactions. Please organize the period for which you need details and which transactions are unclear in the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず記帳と繰り越しの方法を聞きます。新旧の通帳を保管し、半年分の家賃が明細で確認できるか見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記帳と繰越の方法を聞き、新旧の通帳を保管して半年分の家賃を明細で確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first ask how to update it and carry it over. I'll keep the old and new passbooks and would like to check whether I can verify six months of rent in the transaction details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask about updating and carrying over the passbook, keep both old and new ones, and want to check six months of rent in the details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 繰越の窓口相談と、半年分の家賃を個別に見る明細照会の二つを担当へ渡します。新しい通帳の発行や明細の交付が済んだわけではありませんので、新旧の資料を区別して保管してください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass two requests to the person in charge: counter advice on carrying over the passbook and an inquiry for individual details of six months of rent. A new passbook hasn't been issued and the details haven't been provided yet, so keep the old and new records clearly distinguished. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お会計について何を確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to check about your bill?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この洗剤、棚ではもっと安かったと思います。レシートの金額と違うので、確かめてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 洗剤の棚の値段とレシートの金額が違うように見えると伝え、確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought this detergent was cheaper on the shelf. It differs from the amount on my receipt. Could you check?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the shelf price for detergent seems different from the receipt amount, and ask for it to be checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品とレシートを拝見します。棚の値札の写真などはお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me look at the product and receipt. Do you have a photo of the shelf price tag or something similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真があります。でも写真の値札は小さい詰め替え用で、買ったのは大きいものかもしれません。容量を一緒に見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 値札の写真は小さい詰替え用かもしれないと説明し、買った商品の容量と比べたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a photo. But its price tag is for a small refill, and the one I bought may be the large one. I'd like to compare the sizes together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the price-tag photo may be for a small refill, and say you want to compare it with the size of the product you bought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 容量と商品番号を照らし合わせましょう。同じ棚の表示でも別の商品向けの場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's compare the quantity and product number. A label on the same shelf can sometimes be for a different product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きいほうの値札も写っています。こちらの安い金額に「会員」とありますが、私は会員ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大きい商品の値札も写っているが安い価格には会員条件があり、自分は会員ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The large one's price tag is also in the photo. This cheaper price says 'members,' but I'm not a member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the photo also shows the large product's price tag, but its cheaper price has a membership condition and you are not a member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会員向けの価格か、通常価格かも確認します。商品と表示条件が一致しているか、売場で照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll also check whether it's a member price or the regular price. We'll compare the product and the label conditions in the section to see whether they match.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会員価格なら、その金額で払ったつもりだった私の勘違いですね。ただ、通常価格とレシートが同じかは確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会員価格なら自分の勘違いだと認めつつ、通常価格とレシートは一致するか確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: If that's the member price, I was mistaken in thinking I was paying that amount. But I'd still like to check that the regular price matches the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge your misunderstanding if it is a member price, while asking whether the regular price and receipt match. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。条件を確認したうえで、実際の会計価格と比較します。差があれば、その内容と対応を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After checking the conditions, we'll compare them with the actual checkout price. If there's a difference, we'll explain it and what we can do.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 容量と会員条件を分けて確認してください。通常価格で正しければそのままで、会計の誤りなら対応方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容量と会員条件を分けて照合し、正しい通常価格ならそのままにし、誤りがあれば対応を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please check the size and membership conditions separately. If the regular price is correct, leave it as it is. If there's a checkout error, I'd like to ask how it can be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the size and membership conditions separately, leave a correct regular price unchanged, and explain the response if there is an error. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示とレシートを確認し、結果をお伝えします。ご確認いただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check the label and receipt and let you know the result. Thank you for checking with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園のご利用で、何をご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to know about using the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨が強くなったので、子供と休める室内を探しています。この屋根のマークの所へ行けば入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨が強くなったので子供と休める室内を探していると伝え、地図の屋根のマークの場所へ入れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The rain has become heavier, so I'm looking for somewhere indoors to rest with my child. Can we go inside the place with this roof symbol?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the rain has become heavier and you need an indoor rest area for your child, and ask whether you can enter the place marked with a roof on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 地図の凡例を確認しましょう。そのマークは屋外の屋根付き休憩場所を表していて、室内ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the map legend. That symbol means an outdoor covered rest area; it isn't indoors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 室内だと思っていました。子供の上着が濡れたので、雨を避けるだけでなく着替えられる場所が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 屋根のマークを室内だと思っていたと伝え、濡れた子供の上着を着替えられる場所が必要だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was indoors. My child's jacket is wet, so we need somewhere to change clothes, not just shelter from the rain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you thought the roof symbol meant indoors, and explain that you need somewhere to change your child's wet jacket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の案内では、着替えに使える室内は利用できません。屋外の屋根だけでは着替える場所として決められませんね。お車があるなら、駐車場へ戻る経路をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: According to the current information, an indoor changing place isn't available. An outdoor roof alone can't be treated as a changing place. If you have a car, I can show you the route back to the car park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 急いで坂を下りれば近いと思いましたが、濡れて滑りそうです。遠回りでも歩きやすい通路を教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 坂道の近道は濡れて滑りそうだと伝え、遠回りでも歩きやすい通路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought hurrying down the slope would be shorter, but it looks wet and slippery. Please show me an easier path to walk, even if it's a detour.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the sloping shortcut looks wet and slippery, and ask for an easier path even if it is longer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内板の左から続く平らな舗装通路を使ってください。「駐車場」の表示に沿って進む経路です。短い坂の道は使わず、お子さんと一緒に歩いて戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use the flat paved path starting to the left of the information board. Follow the signs for 'Car park.' You can walk back together with your child without using the short sloping path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は散歩をやめます。室内は使えないとわかったので、車へ戻って着替えます。案内板左の平らな道と駐車場の表示を、地図でも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着替えの室内は使えないので散歩をやめて車へ戻ると伝え、案内板左の平らな通路と駐車場表示を地図で確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll stop our walk today. Now I know indoors isn't available, we'll go back to the car to change. I'd also like to check the flat path to the board's left and car-park signs on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will stop the walk and return to the car because an indoor changing place is unavailable, and ask to check the flat path to the board's left and car-park signs on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが案内板左の通路です。地図でも駐車場につながっています。現地に通行止めがあれば進まず、ご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the path to the left of the board. The map also shows it connecting to the car park. If there's a closure on site, don't continue; please ask us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 屋根の印は室内ではなく、着替えの室内も使えないと確認できました。子供と一緒に案内板左の平らな通路を通って車へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 屋根の印は室内ではなく着替えの室内も利用不可と確認し、子供と案内板左の平らな道から車へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed that the roof symbol isn't indoors and an indoor changing place isn't available either. I'll return to the car with my child along the flat path to the left of the board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the roof symbol is not indoors and an indoor changing place is unavailable, and say you will return to the car with your child along the flat path to the board's left. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お子さんと足元に気をつけて移動してください。状況が悪ければ、近道を使わず戻ってください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please watch your footing as you go with your child. If conditions are bad, turn back rather than take a shortcut. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お忘れ物の受取りについて、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with collecting your lost property?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅から眼鏡ケースが見つかったと連絡が来ました。明日帰るので、受取方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅から眼鏡ケースが見つかったと連絡が来たので、翌日帰る前に受取方法を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The station contacted me to say my glasses case was found. I'm heading home tomorrow, so I'd like to discuss how to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the station contacted you about a found glasses case and you want to discuss collection before going home the next day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 連絡に、保管している場所は書かれていますか。電話をした窓口と保管先が同じか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the message say where it's being kept? Let's check whether the counter that called and the storage location are the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話してきた窓口へ行けば受け取れると思っていました。このメモでは別の駅が保管先になっているので、先に場所を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話してきた窓口と保管している駅を混同し、連絡元へ行けば受け取れると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I could collect it by going to the counter that called. This note gives another station as the storage location, so I'll check the place first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you confused the calling counter with the station storing it and thought you could collect it from the caller's location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 連絡元は窓口Aですが、保管案内には窓口B、照会番号G-14とあります。ご本人の受取期限は10月8日です。ご本人が行く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Counter A contacted you, but the storage instructions say counter B and reference number G-14. Your deadline for personal collection is October 8. Are you planning to go yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 知人に頼めるかもしれません。代理で受け取れるかと、必要な確認事項を先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 知人に受取を頼む可能性があるので、代理受取の可否と必要な確認事項を先に尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I may be able to ask an acquaintance. I'd like to first ask whether someone can collect it on my behalf and what needs to be checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you may ask an acquaintance to collect it and first want to ask whether collection by a representative is allowed and what checks are required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 代理受取は、この案内だけでは可否が決まっていません。窓口Bへ個別に確認が必要です。ご本人なら10月8日までですが、その間に行ける日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: These instructions alone don't establish whether someone else can collect it. You need to check directly with counter B. For personal collection, you have until October 8. Is there a day you can go before then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 知人の予定は未確定ですが、私は10月6日に行けます。期限内なので、代理は申し込まず本人受取で、Bに訪問時刻を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 知人は未定だが自分は期限内の10月6日に行けるので、代理を申し込まず保管先Bへ本人受取の時刻を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My acquaintance's plans aren't fixed, but I can go on October 6. Since that's before the deadline, I won't request collection by someone else. I'd like to confirm a time with B to collect it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your acquaintance’s plans are not yet confirmed, but you can go on October 6 within the deadline, so you will not request collection by a representative and want to check a personal collection time with storage counter B. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本人受取の希望ですね。G-14を伝えて、10月6日の希望時刻と持参物を窓口Bへ確認しましょう。来訪の時刻はまだ予約していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You'd like to collect it yourself, then. Let's give G-14 and check your preferred time on October 6 and what to bring with counter B. A visit time hasn't been booked yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡元Aではなく保管先Bへ、G-14で本人受取を相談します。10月6日の時刻と持参物を確認してから訪問し、代理は申し込みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡元Aでなく保管先Bへ照会番号G-14で本人受取を相談し、10月6日の訪問時刻と持参物を確認してから行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll contact storage counter B, not the caller A, using G-14 to arrange personal collection. I'll check the time on October 6 and what to bring before visiting, and won't request a representative.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss personal collection with storage counter B rather than caller A using G-14, and confirm the October 6 visit time and required items before going. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。保管案内にBとG-14、期限10月8日があることを確認できました。来訪時刻はBの回答をお待ちください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We've confirmed that the storage instructions list B, G-14, and the October 8 deadline. Please wait for B's reply about the visit time. Take care.
